# AI Subscription Payback

> Free, static calculator that estimates how long until buying a local AI inference box (Mac Studio, NVIDIA DGX Spark, or Strix Halo / Ryzen AI Max class) is cheaper than paying for AI coding subscriptions like Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Google AI (Gemini / Jules / Antigravity), Replit Agent, Mistral, Bolt, Lovable, Augment Code, Amp, TRAE, Supermaven, Warp, Kiro, Factory, Manus, and v0.

The site is a single static page hosted on GitHub Pages at https://www.othree.cloud/ai-subscription-payback/. All computation runs client-side in the browser — there is no backend or API. It is affiliate-funded, and affiliate relationships never change the calculator's math or results. Pricing figures are hand-maintained snapshots with a visible "last updated" date; always confirm current prices with the vendor before buying.

## Calculator

- [Payback calculator](https://www.othree.cloud/ai-subscription-payback/#calculator): Enter your monthly subscription spend and a hardware price to see the break-even month where owning a local box beats renting subscriptions. Runs entirely in the browser.

## Methodology and assumptions

- [Methodology & FAQ](https://www.othree.cloud/ai-subscription-payback/#methodology): How the payback is computed, what costs are included, and the assumptions and limits behind the estimate. The on-page FAQ is also published as FAQPage structured data.

## Disclosures

- [Pricing disclosure](https://www.othree.cloud/ai-subscription-payback/#pricing): Subscription and hardware prices are manually maintained snapshots shown with a "Pricing last updated" date; verify current pricing with each vendor.
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://www.othree.cloud/ai-subscription-payback/#affiliate): Some outbound hardware links are affiliate links marked "(affiliate)"; purchases may earn a commission at no extra cost to you and never affect the calculator's results.
